69. CHIEF MINISTER’S COMPREHENSIVE HEALTH INSURANCE SCHEME 
 
Gist of the Scheme 
In order to achieve the objective of universal health care 
Government has implemented a comprehensive health 
insurance scheme to benefit the differently abled  
persons. Under this scheme, all the differently  abled  
persons   and their family members are enrolled without 
any income ceiling. 
Eligibility Criteria for admission 
To be a resident of Tamil Nadu any one member of the 
family should be a differently abled person.  
Whether form of application is 
prescribed 
Yes. Available with insurance office in Collectorate. 
Certificates to be furnished 
Photocopy of the ration card, National I.D. Card 
Officer to whom the application 
is to be submitted 
District Differently Abled Welfare Officers. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Special Officer,  
O/o. The Commissionerate  for Welfare of the  
Differently abled, 
No.5, Kamarajar salai, 
Chennai – 600 005.  
Ph: 044-28444940
